user.title: Sign in to your Cremalink cloud account
user.description: Enter your cloud account email and password to automatically discover and set up your coffee machine. Check "Advanced setup" to configure a device manually instead.

device_select.title: Select Device
device_select.description: Your cloud account has more than one coffee machine. Choose which one to add.

manual_map.title: Select Device Model
manual_map.description: We could not automatically identify the model for {device_name} ({dsn}). Please select it manually.

manual.title: Select Connection Method
manual.description: Choose how you want to connect to your Cremalink device.

cloud_auth.title: Cloud Authentication
cloud_auth.description: Enter your refresh token to authenticate with the cloud service.

cloud_device.title: Select Device
cloud_device.description: Select the device you wish to add.

device.title: Configure device
device.description: Enter the credentials of your coffee machine.

data.advertised_ip: Host IP address advertised to coffee machine (optional)

data_description.advertised_ip: Enter the host's LAN IPv4 address when Home Assistant runs in Docker bridge networking. Leave blank to auto-detect.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {device_name}
reconfigure.description: This device was set up using the Cremalink Server add-on, which is no longer required. Confirm below to switch {device_name} ({dsn}) to the built-in local server. You can uninstall the add-on afterwards.

data.advertised_ip: Advertised IP (optional — leave blank to auto-detect)

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to server. Is the URL correct and the server running?
error.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Please check your credentials.
error.missing_credentials: Please enter both email and password, or check Advanced setup.
error.no_devices: No devices found on this account.
error.no_coffee_machine: This account has devices, but none of them are recognized as a coffee machine.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Device switched to the built-in local server.

init.title: Local connection settings
init.description: Set the polling interval and the IP address the coffee machine should use to reach this Home Assistant instance.

data_description.advertised_ip: Enter the host's LAN IPv4 address when using Docker bridge networking. The coffee machine must be able to reach this address. Leave blank to auto-detect.

error.invalid_monitor_poll_interval: Enter a whole number between 1 and 60 seconds.

abort.local_only: These options are available only for local connections.

reconfigure_required.title: {device_name} needs to be reconfigured
reconfigure_required.description: The Cremalink Server add-on is no longer required for local mode. {device_name} ({dsn}) is still using it — reconfigure this device to switch to the built-in local server, then you can uninstall the add-on.
